{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''mercenary''' hired by the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kam Nale]]<ref name="SWB">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref> captured the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|hit-man]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]]<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #49]] provides a [[Great ReSynchronization]] date of 13:3:28. This date corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]].</ref> Aldar Beedo, also known as a professional [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], was participating in the [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] race, located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], when the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Blaster/Legends|shot]] Beedo down during the middle of the race and arrested the Glymphid.<ref name="HNN" /> Beedo was then brought back to Nale's headquarters, where he would pay for the crime of [[Death/Legends|murdering]] Nale's [[Borzu Nale|father]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier.<ref name="SWB" /> The overall event was later chronicled in an [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that called the future of Podracing into question, citing the incident along with several other questionable events related to Podracing.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mercenary was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #49'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[March 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN49 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6217551|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Dev Sibwarra|date=2002-03-28|time=4:24 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref>
